scenario.title: 請同事、客戶幫忙的信件和訊息
scenario.context: 工作 email 的語氣很微妙：太直接像在命令，太客氣又顯得囉嗦。Would you mind…? 和 Could you…? 是最好用的請託句型，但 Would you mind 的回答方式會讓很多台灣人答反。

dialogues.title: An email thread with a client

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Hi Ms. Lin, I hope you're doing well. I've attached the first draft of the menu design.
lines.zh: 林小姐您好，希望您一切順利。附上菜單設計的初稿。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Would you mind sharing your feedback by Friday? That way we can stay on schedule for printing.
lines.zh: 方便請您在週五前給我回饋嗎？這樣我們印刷時程才能照原訂計畫。

lines.speaker: Ms. Lin
lines.en: Thanks, Minz! It looks great. I'm looping in our marketing manager, Tony, since he'll need to approve the prices.
lines.zh: 謝謝 Minz！看起來很棒。我把行銷經理 Tony 加進來，因為價格需要他核准。

lines.speaker: Tony
lines.en: Hi Minz, nice to meet you. Would you mind making the prices a little bigger? Some of our customers are older.
lines.zh: Minz 你好，很高興認識你。方便把價格字放大一點嗎？我們有些客人年紀比較大。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Not at all! I'll send an updated version by tomorrow afternoon.
lines.zh: 完全沒問題！我明天下午前寄更新版本。

lines.speaker: Tony
lines.en: Perfect, thanks. FYI, we might add two new drinks next week, so please leave some space.
lines.zh: 太好了，謝謝。另外跟你說，我們下週可能會加兩款新飲品，請留點空間。

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Hey, sorry to ping you. Do you have the brand fonts? The client needs them ASAP.
lines.zh: 嘿，抱歉打擾。你有品牌字體檔嗎？客戶急著要。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: Sure, I'll send them now. Would you mind reminding them that one of the fonts needs a license?
lines.zh: 有，我現在傳。可以麻煩你提醒他們其中一套字需要授權嗎？

lines.speaker: Daniel
lines.en: Good catch. Could you forward me the license link too?
lines.zh: 好險你有注意到。可以也把授權連結轉給我嗎？

patterns.note: email 開頭的客套，取代「您好」
比 Please find attached 自然現代

patterns.zh: 方便請您在週五前 ___ 嗎？

patterns.en: Could you let me know if ___?
patterns.zh: 可以請你告訴我是否 ___ 嗎？

patterns.en: Please let me know if you have any questions.
Looking forward to hearing from you.

chinglish.wrong: Please help me check this file.
chinglish.right: Could you take a look at this file?
chinglish.why: 「請幫我…」直翻成 Please help me… 很常見，但英文 help 暗示對方在幫你一個私人忙，工作上的請託用 Could you… 更自然。

chinglish.wrong: A: Would you mind sending it again? B: Yes, of course!
chinglish.right: B: Not at all! / No problem!
chinglish.why: Would you mind 字面是「你介意嗎」，回答 Yes 是「我介意」。答應要說 Not at all / No problem / Of course not。

chinglish.wrong: Please reply me as soon as possible.
chinglish.right: Could you get back to me when you have a chance?
chinglish.why: reply 後面要加 to；而且 as soon as possible 放在信裡語氣很急，除非真的很急才用。

chinglish.wrong: Dear Minz, how are you? I am fine.
chinglish.right: Hi Minz, I hope you're doing well.
chinglish.why: How are you? I am fine. 是課本對話，不適合放在信裡。

grammar.title: Would you mind + V-ing
grammar.oneLiner: Would you mind + V-ing? 是很客氣的請託，意思是「你介意…嗎？」，所以答應時要說 Not at all。
whenToUse: Would you mind + V-ing：請對方做事。Would you mind sending it again?
Would you mind if I + 過去式：請求自己做事的許可。Would you mind if I left early?
Do you mind + V-ing：語氣稍微直接一點。
答應：Not at all. / No, go ahead. / Of course not. / Sure（口語常見，雖然邏輯上怪，但大家都這樣說）。
拒絕：Actually, I'd rather you didn't. / Sorry, I'm a bit busy right now.
禮貌度排序：Can you… < Could you… < Would you mind… < I was wondering if you could…
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文的「方便…嗎？」「可以…嗎？」答應就說「好」「可以」。但 Would you mind 問的是「你介意嗎」，所以「好」要說成「不介意」。台灣人常直覺回 Yes，對方會愣一下。另外 mind 後面接 V-ing（第 14 單元學過），很多人會寫成 mind to send。

examples.correct: Would you mind resending the file?
examples.incorrect: Would you mind to resend the file?

examples.correct: A: Would you mind closing the door? B: Not at all.
examples.incorrect: A: Would you mind closing the door? B: Yes.
examples.note: 答應要說 Not at all。

examples.correct: Would you mind if I joined the call a few minutes late?
examples.note: 請求自己做事，if + 過去式（假設語氣，更客氣）。

examples.correct: Could you send me the invoice?
examples.note: Could you 也很禮貌，日常 email 最常用。

examples.correct: I was wondering if you could review the draft by Friday.
examples.note: 最委婉的請託，適合對客戶或上司。

quiz.question: Would you mind ___ the report by Thursday?
A: Would you mind if I opened the window? B: ___ (你答應)
quiz.explanation: 答應要說 Not at all。

quiz.question: Would you mind ___ (send) me the latest version?
Which is the MOST polite?
options: Can you send me the file?
I was wondering if you could send me the file.
quiz.explanation: I was wondering if you could… 最委婉。

quiz.question: Would you mind if I ___ (bring) a friend to the dinner?
quiz.explanation: Would you mind if I + 過去式最客氣，口語也會聽到現在式。

slang.usage: 可以唸成 A-S-A-P 或 /ˈeɪsæp/。工作訊息很常見。

risk.note: 語氣很急，對上司或客戶寫 ASAP 可能顯得在催促，改用 at your earliest convenience 或 when you get a chance。

examples.en: The client needs the logo files ASAP.
Please call me back ASAP. It's urgent.

slang.meaning: 僅供參考、跟你說一聲（for your information）
slang.usage: 分享資訊但不需要對方做什麼時用，email 和聊天都很普遍。

risk.note: 口頭說 Just FYI 有時帶「我先說喔」的不悅語氣，像在提醒對方錯了。

examples.en: FYI, the office will be closed on Friday.
examples.zh: 跟大家說，週五辦公室不開。

examples.en: Just FYI, the client prefers email over phone calls.
examples.zh: 提醒一下，客戶比較喜歡 email 不喜歡電話。

slang.meaning: 把某人加進討論、讓某人知情
slang.usage: loop someone in = 把某人加入信件或對話。keep me in the loop = 有消息要讓我知道。

examples.en: I'm looping in Tony from marketing.
examples.zh: 我把行銷部的 Tony 加進來。

examples.en: Can you loop me in on the next client call?
examples.zh: 下次客戶電話可以讓我加入嗎？

slang.usage: 用 Slack、LINE 等快速聯絡某人：I'll ping you when it's ready.

risk.note: 科技業和年輕職場很常用，傳統產業的人可能覺得太隨性。

examples.en: Ping me if you need anything.
Sorry to ping you on a Sunday.
examples.zh: 抱歉週日還傳訊息給你。

review.question: Which is correct?
review.explanation: 複習第 22 單元：agree 是動詞。

review.question: Let's put a ___ in that and discuss it next week.
review.explanation: 複習第 22 單元：put a pin in it = 先擱著。

review.question: I've been in this industry ___ ten years.
review.explanation: 複習第 21 單元：一段時間用 for。

review.question: ___ a helpful email!
review.explanation: 複習第 19 單元：What a + 形容詞 + 名詞。

review.question: Which is correct?
options: I check always my email first.
I always check my email first.
Always I check first my email.
review.explanation: 複習第 15 單元：頻率副詞放一般動詞前。

review.question: ___ getting late. Let's finish this tomorrow.
review.explanation: 複習第 7 單元：時間用虛主詞 It。

review.question: A: Would you mind checking this for me? B: ___
review.explanation: 答應要說 Not at all。
